requestable_evidence_items.evidence_item: Throughput by shift, process map, thermal systems, compressed air uses, and maintenance evidence
requestable_evidence_items.source: Operator, production, maintenance, and EHS records
requestable_evidence_items.why_needed: Required to distinguish structural process load from support-system waste and to build a fair peer frame.

pack_stop_conditions.minimum_sufficient_evidence: equipment inventory covering process and support systems
pack_stop_conditions.stop_condition: equipment inventory pack received or explicitly unavailable
pack_stop_conditions.downgrade_condition: no equipment inventory available through engineering route
pack_stop_conditions.escalation_condition: ask maintenance / facility engineer for equipment inventory

pack_stop_conditions.minimum_sufficient_evidence: throughput by shift, duty cycle, and product mix
pack_stop_conditions.stop_condition: throughput schedule pack received or explicitly unavailable
pack_stop_conditions.downgrade_condition: no throughput schedule pack available through production route
pack_stop_conditions.escalation_condition: ask operator for throughput by shift, duty cycle, and product mix

pack_stop_conditions.stop_condition: maintenance proof pack received or explicitly unavailable
pack_stop_conditions.downgrade_condition: no maintenance proof available through maintenance route
pack_stop_conditions.escalation_condition: ask maintenance manager for PM proof and downtime history

pack_stop_conditions.stop_condition: CMMS or workorder pack received or explicitly unavailable
pack_stop_conditions.downgrade_condition: no CMMS extract available through maintenance route
pack_stop_conditions.escalation_condition: ask maintenance manager for CMMS or work orders

pack_stop_conditions.minimum_sufficient_evidence: permit detail pack covering regulated equipment
pack_stop_conditions.stop_condition: permit detail pack received or explicitly unavailable
pack_stop_conditions.downgrade_condition: no permit detail pack available through operator or EHS route
pack_stop_conditions.escalation_condition: ask owner / operator / EHS lead for permit detail pack
